name: Training_Fabric_Controller
description: Collects health and API performance for an enterprise fabric controller.
technicalNotes: Single-instance workshop DataSource. Requires the Training Fabric PropertySource.

datapoints.name: controller_health
datapoints.description: Controller health status; 1 is healthy and 0 is unhealthy.

datapoints.name: node_count
datapoints.description: Number of fabric nodes reported by the controller.

datapoints.name: api_latency_ms
datapoints.description: Controller API response latency in milliseconds.
